description:
Design and develop native iOS mobile applications for the smartphone, tablets, wearables and other Apple devices.   
 Experience in software development with a strong command of object oriented principles   
 Experience releasing at least one/two application into the App Store   
 Deep understanding of iOS UX and UI design paradigms   
 In-depth knowledge of Objective-C, XCode, UIKit and Interface Builder   
 Good know-how of data structures, algorithms and design patterns   
 Experience working with and tuning mobile applications   
 Experience with web service integration (REST, JSON, XML), core data and AFNetworking.   

 Responsibilities:   

 Responsible for working on different layers of the iOS apps   
 Help architect and maintain our set of native mobile applications   
 Work closely with design and product team to architect application flows seamlessly and works intuitively with users   
 Building applications in memory- and network-constrained scenarios   
 provide solution for every aspect of the iOS development process from API creation, design, and product   
 Participate in the full SDLC (RUP/Agile), including meetings, iterative development, estimations and design sessions 


 Objective-C, XCode, UIKit,REST, JSON, XML 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
